answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, bound to a delay function and encoded in a secure cipher, constrain autonomous agents so identity cloning demands an intractable search space, rendering a spoofed signal indistinguishable from genuine state. To enforce Byzantine fault tolerance, cryptoeconomic primitives mandate staking collateral and slashing penalties, guaranteeing negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium that preserves this consensus oasis against adversarial Sybil amplification while ensuring cryptographic finality.
